common.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:

confirmSignup.subject: Confirm your ToothOps account
confirmSignup.title: Confirm your email
confirmSignup.preheader: Confirm your email to activate your ToothOps account.
confirmSignup.body: Welcome to ToothOps. Confirm {{email}} to activate your practice account — you’ll be signed in right away.
confirmSignup.ignore: Didn’t sign up for ToothOps? You can ignore this email — the account stays inactive unless this link is used.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your ToothOps password
resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.preheader: Reset the password for your ToothOps account.
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for {{email}}. The link is valid for one hour.
resetPassword.ignore: Didn’t ask for this? Ignore this email — your password stays the same.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for ToothOps
changeEmail.title: Confirm your new email
changeEmail.preheader: Confirm the new email address for your ToothOps account.
changeEmail.body: Confirm that {{newEmail}} should replace {{email}} as the sign-in email for your ToothOps account.
changeEmail.ignore: Didn’t request this change? Ignore this email and your sign-in email stays the same.

invite.subject: You’re invited to ToothOps
invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.preheader: You’ve been invited to create a ToothOps account.
invite.body: You’ve been invited to create a ToothOps account for {{email}}. Accept the invitation to set your password and get started.
invite.ignore: Not expecting this invitation? You can ignore this email — no account is created unless this link is used.

magiclink.subject: Your ToothOps sign-in link
magiclink.title: Sign in to ToothOps
magiclink.preheader: Your link to sign in to ToothOps.
magiclink.body: Use the button below to sign in to ToothOps as {{email}}. The link can be used only once.
magiclink.ignore: Didn’t try to sign in? Ignore this email — no one can sign in without this link.

reauthentication.subject: Your ToothOps verification code
reauthentication.title: Confirm it’s you
reauthentication.body: Enter this code in ToothOps to confirm it’s you:
reauthentication.ignore: Didn’t request this code? Ignore this email, and consider changing your password.

notice.footnote: If you didn’t make this change, reset your password right away.

passwordChanged.subject: Your ToothOps password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your ToothOps account was changed.

emailChanged.subject: Your ToothOps sign-in email was changed
emailChanged.body: The sign-in email for your ToothOps account was changed.

phoneChanged.subject: Your ToothOps phone number was changed
phoneChanged.body: The phone number for your ToothOps account was changed.

identityLinked.subject: A sign-in method was added to your ToothOps account
identityLinked.body: A new sign-in method was linked to your ToothOps account.

identityUnlinked.subject: A sign-in method was removed from your ToothOps account
identityUnlinked.body: A sign-in method was removed from your ToothOps account.

mfaEnrolled.subject: Two-factor authentication was added to your ToothOps account
mfaEnrolled.body: A two-factor authentication method was added to your ToothOps account.

mfaUnenrolled.subject: Two-factor authentication was removed from your ToothOps account
mfaUnenrolled.body: A two-factor authentication method was removed from your ToothOps account.

generic.subject: Your ToothOps account was updated
generic.body: A security setting on your ToothOps account was changed.
